_readme: The ZAYA website AI assistant's OWN switch. It is deliberately NOT in src/content/data/site.json and NOT in the CMS: publish (indexing) and assistant exposure are separate decisions with separate owners, and only the founder may move this one. See docs/ASSISTANT-GATE.md.
_enabled: true only after the founder's W-D4b public-launch gate. false = no assistant markup is emitted on any page at all.
_publicLaunchApproved: The founder's W-D4b record. scripts/check-publish.mjs FAILS a publish build if the assistant resolves ON while this is not true.
